notes.title: Bloody Update
notes.content:
We are pleased to present the first major update for the game!

Blood!!!
Now blood is everywhere! When enemy hit by bullets, when limb seperates and explosion tears the enemy to shreds, leaving a pool of blood.
https://media.giphy.com/media/llg4FvPdxUSHFMbs9N/source.gif

Throwing grenades improved
We heard your pain about how difficult it is to aim with a grenade or dynamite, and changed the mechanics - it became more convenient, try it!
https://media.giphy.com/media/h6fjkdql4pJQkAUlNW/source.gif

Casino
Try your luck between levels! Do not wait to return to base to spend diamonds.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33779370/9ae2412c96c9f57fee8cc37df0d14e8778f297ec.gif

Cars is dangerous
You can easily shoot down trees and break through enemies, leaving a trail of blood.
https://media.giphy.com/media/KcDqLLvpAijJiZB6D0/source.gif

Loading Tips
Now you can read tips between level loading.
By the way, you can send your advice to our Discord
https://media.giphy.com/media/Tk0j9ZqQHMmOyKpSyl/source.gif

Other improvements

:fpplus: The new character - Terminator - will be available after passing the 5th level.
:fpplus: Armor now drops out of enemies, if health is full.
:fpplus: Added sand particles under the player and helicopter.
:fpplus: The sound of car collision now depends on the type of surface, speed and impact force.
:fpplus: New animation - hostages in captivity are on their knees.
:fpplus: The player pays for destruction of car in the store - be careful.
:fpplus: Added logo DESERT KILL when starting the game.

:orwell_check: Set up the shadows, now the objects are not floating in the air.
:orwell_check: Changing weapons by pressing 1,2,3,4 ... 9 works.
:orwell_check: Fixed 34 other minor bugs.

What's next?

We have a plan for the coming months and we will talk about it soon.
We have already started working on some cool features - they will appear in the next updates.

Controller support
We brought to our office all gamepads that we found and we already started working on adding contoller support to the game!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33779370/57da3e4ad2f955d9623d87b7a5bb4e7392bc58b2.jpg

Thanks for support!
Thanks to all the players, especially those who stream and upload videos on youtube!
We watch every video and fix bugs thanks to you!
---
Join Discord!
